description: Catalog of unreferenced, disconnected, or uninvoked code components identified during repository audit.

unknowns.description: Interactive multiple choice question prompt defined in the CLI layer, but never injected into CodingOrchestratorWorkflow or called by any active workflow node.
unknowns.impact: Code bloat and misleading intent mapping; clarification loops cannot actually execute interactively.
unknowns.recommendation: Either wire this callback into CodingOrchestratorWorkflow as an approval/clarification hook or remove it if clarification is automated.

unknowns.description: Interactive human approval gate implementing Rule R4 (Approve, Minor Tweak, Scope Change, Abort), but never injected into CodingOrchestratorWorkflow or executed in the graph.
unknowns.impact: Orchestrator proceeds through steps without waiting for human approval gate confirmation despite Rule R4 specifications.
unknowns.recommendation: Inject as an approval gate callback into CodingOrchestratorWorkflow between pipeline steps or document as planned interactive gate.

unknowns.description: CLI option `--yes` / `-y` is accepted and prints '[dim]Auto-approve mode enabled[/dim]', but the boolean value is never passed to CodingOrchestratorWorkflow.start() or inspected by any execution node.
unknowns.impact: Users pass `--yes` expecting non-interactive mode, but the flag has no operational effect because the workflow has no interactive gates to bypass.
unknowns.recommendation: Wire auto_approve to CodingOrchestratorWorkflow once terminal_approval_gate is connected.

unknowns.description: Configuration models CoddyConfig, CodingSanitizeConfig, and CodingResearchPlanConfig define model names and thinking budgets, but are never imported in app/coddy/agentic/ or app/coddy/cli/. Agents hardcode model strings ('gemini-3.5-flash-lite', 'gemini-3.8-flash').
unknowns.impact: Config settings in config.py cannot be modified by users to alter agent behavior; changes in config.py have no runtime effect.
unknowns.recommendation: Import CoddyConfig in CodingSanitizerAgent and CodingResearchPlannerAgent so model names and thinking budgets are configurable.

unknowns.description: Pre-flight validation ensuring required local LLM models are loaded on http://localhost:1234/v1. Function is thoroughly tested in tests/test_model_verifier.py, but is never invoked before CodingOrchestratorWorkflow.start() in code_cmd.
unknowns.impact: If a required local model is absent, the workflow fails mid-execution with an unhandled exception rather than failing fast at startup.
unknowns.recommendation: Invoke verify_models() inside code_cmd() before instantiating or starting CodingOrchestratorWorkflow.

unknowns.description: Helper functions find_agents_markdown(), find_skills_directory(), get_local_skills_summary(), and extract_reasoning() are defined in json_helpers.py but never imported or called anywhere across the application runtime.
unknowns.impact: Dead utility code increasing cognitive overhead and maintenance burden.
unknowns.recommendation: Incorporate into load_project_context() to dynamically locate local project instructions (AGENTS.md) and skills, or delete if obsolete.

unknowns.description: GraphRAGTools defines 11 comprehensive tools (search_facts, search_documents, get_code_entity, get_call_hierarchy, list_files, web_search, etc.) tested in tests/test_graphrag.py, but neither CodingSanitizerAgent nor CodingResearchPlannerAgent includes them in their tools list (only read_file is used).
unknowns.impact: GraphRAG knowledge graph and vector store are ingested and tested, but no worker agent actually queries them during workflow execution.
unknowns.recommendation: Equip CodingResearchPlannerAgent with GraphRAGTools so it can query codebase entities and documentation during research decomposition.

unknowns.description: Specification and Plan schemas, along with SpecificationMapper and PlanMapper, are fully implemented and tested, but steps 5 and 6 in CodingOrchestratorWorkflow (step_5_node, step_6_node) are currently empty passthroughs ('pass'). Schemas are only exposed via 'coddy schemas'.
unknowns.impact: The RTD workflow currently terminates after Step 2 (ResearchPlan); downstream specification and implementation plan generation are not active.
unknowns.recommendation: Implement Step 5 (coding-specify) and Step 6 (coding-plan) worker agents to consume ResearchPlan and produce Specification and Plan artifacts.

unknowns.description: get_memory_db_path() returns '~/.coddy/memory.db' with docstring 'Path to the LadybugDB database for long-term memory'. However, LadybugDB is not installed as a dependency and no code interacts with this database path.
unknowns.impact: Architectural documentation lists LadybugDB as tiered storage, but GraphRAG actually uses FalkorDBLite and Qdrant in .cache/graphrag/.
unknowns.recommendation: Document memory.db as a planned migration target or remove get_memory_db_path until LadybugDB integration is implemented.
